parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Varex reports on a fiscal year ending near the end of September; this release covers fiscal Q1 2026. The exact period-end dates (2026-01-02, 2024-12-27, 2025-10-03) are inferred from Varex's usual Friday-close fiscal calendar and are not printed in the excerpt. Adjusted EBITDA definitions changed this release: gains and losses from equity-method investments are now excluded. The prior-year Q1 figure of $25.5M is the restated figure ('as adjusted'); the originally reported figure was $23.8M. The FY2025 total of $124.2M is the restated figure; it was originally reported as $121.9M. The restated Q2–Q4 2025 quarters ($36.2M, $27.5M, $35.0M) are also shown but are not included here, since they are neither the current quarter, the prior-year quarter, nor a year total.
